title: Microsoft Teams Rooms: IntelliFrame people labels name in-room participants
summary: The rollout, automatic enablement, licence requirement and three control surfaces are supported; the cited Learn pages opened successfully despite the earlier rate-limit responses. The question treating the Teams Rooms Pro price as unpublished is misleading: Microsoft publishes a US price of $40 per room per month, paid yearly. The categorical statement that the feature cannot act on behalf of users is also unsupported.
